name_note: Many genomes that GTDB places in Butyribacter carry Lachnoclostridium or Clostridium names in NCBI, so the literature name follows the genomes labelled Butyribacter.

sentences.text: It is a member of the family Lachnospiraceae, and its end products of glucose fermentation were butyric acid and a small amount of acetic acid.
A study reported the relative abundance of Butyribacter intestini to be inversely associated with pneumonia risk.
Another study reported that carriage of the protist Blastocystis, found in 48 percent of participants, was associated with enrichment of butyrate-producing bacteria including Butyribacter.
